note: Cross-stack TLS provider labels for the entity-read-by-id TLS-tax runtime benchmark. result.json.tls only records {"enabled":true}; this file documents the actual TLS engine/provider per arm for honest cross-stack labeling per the CLAUDE.md TLS reporting checklist (buffer/transport/allocator/provider model labels).
level: runtime / integration-level: real HTTPS server, real loopback socket, includes kernel I/O. NOT the JMH engine-level lens (B3/B4/B5).

exeris-community.provider_family: native, off-heap (SPI-native TlsEngine under FD-owner ownership)
exeris-community.closest_jmh_lens: B6 (SPI-native TlsEngine, real loopback socket, includes kernel I/O)
exeris-community.subsystems_for_tls: http,persistence,crypto (crypto subsystem loaded only for the TLS arm)

quarkus-tuned.not_jsse: JSSE (JDK SSLEngine) is the DEFAULT non-tuned quarkus-benchmark-app; the -tuned archetype ships native epoll + native BoringSSL on by default

comparison_axis: native-vs-native TLS: Exeris OffHeapTlsEngine vs BoringSSL/tcnative. Same cipher + TLS version, both integration-level on a real loopback socket. NOT native-vs-JSSE.
source_of_truth: targets/quarkus-benchmark-app-tuned/pom.xml (desc + netty-tcnative-boringssl-static dep) and src/main/resources/application.properties (exeris.transport.tls.native default true, prefer-native-transport true)
